6d203c86-b6e0-586a-b896-b654fa319ed1.content: Conduct one review prior to submission focusing solely on the validity of user problems, system interventions, and field evaluation logic.

6b75bfb1-67f5-50bb-9e0c-04026062de96.content: Cross-check whether research questions align with the core functions of the system.

3abfda89-82ab-5cc5-bdcd-5e2f274fd727.content: Cross-check whether field tasks align with representative measures.

f14f1974-9035-5a2c-931a-89a5004a2567.content: Cross-check whether the evidence to be collected aligns with the design and operational decisions to be changed.

6ba1d344-5d98-5c25-ba1e-b28c08d39747.content: Finally verify that the user problem, system intervention, field evaluation, and expected contribution form one coherent logical flow.

4a85ebbd-a4ee-5c88-9e93-5fc545f41c64.content: HCI reviewers view the validity of design interventions as low if research questions do not connect to system functions.

75c4c71d-28e3-559c-99d1-f0dccc31a9e2.content: HCI reviewers view the validity of evaluation plans as low if field tasks fail to generate representative measures.

577e5506-78e8-5768-b288-7a5986347cce.content: HCI reviewers view the practical utility of contributions as low if collected evidence cannot change design or operational decisions.

9ce34a9a-4ba2-5b32-a1de-b0469ddc3f95.content: Before submission, conduct a sequential walkthrough with field liaisons of installation failures, operational interruptions, and recovery scenarios.

f8253f92-c60c-57e1-a630-6b31abe080ae.content: Verify in one sentence how each proposed contribution could actually alter specific design or operational decisions.

f5ad6933-3e22-5c47-bdaf-bacc9c9a5b3c.content: The agent cannot distinguish remaining execution risks if unconfirmed field partners and equipment are presented as finalized.
